This time we received five bytes first and * then the rest. You never know how many bytes you get. * * A typical packet for player version 2.0 (beta): * * 0000:50 4E 41 00 06 00 02 00 00 00 01 00 02 1B C1 00 PNA............. * 0010:00 67 75 78 F5 63 00 0A 57 69 6E 32 2E 30 2E 30 .gux.c..Win2.0.0 * 0020:2E 35 6C 00 00 52 00 1C 72 61 66 69 6C 65 73 2F .5l..R..rafiles/ * 0030:77 65 62 73 69 74 65 2F 32 30 72 65 6C 65 61 73 website/20releas * 0040:65 2E 72 61 79 53 00 00 06 36 42 e.rayS...6B * * Port number 0x1BC1 is found at offset 0x0d. * * This is just a horrible switch statement.
